extension.description: A configurable video add-on for Kodi. Browse categories, search, keep favorites and a resume-aware watch history, and play from a content source you configure. Content-source agnostic: point it at your own JSON API or HTML source.
extension.news: v1.1.5 - Five features added: resume badges with progress percentage in video listings (Progress, ResumeLabel properties); Trakt.tv scrobbling to track watch progress across devices (trakt_id on videos, trakt_enabled/username/token settings); subtitle URL passing on streams (subtitle field on Stream, setSubtitles); watch progress percentage in listings; and a content source switcher (multiple sources in sources.json, Switch source action). v1.1.4 - Preview images: videos may now include an optional "preview" URL (a still or animated frame). When provided it is shown as the listing's fanart/background image so the video content is identifiable at a glance; "thumb" remains the poster thumbnail.
